literature.claim: Validated IVP methods return guaranteed solution enclosures under stated success hypotheses, unlike mere error estimates.
literature.reference: Nedialkov, Jackson & Corliss (1999), Validated solutions of IVPs for ODEs

literature.claim: Taylor models reduce interval dependency/wrapping but require a sound remainder enclosure.
literature.reference: Neher, Jackson & Nedialkov (2007), On Taylor Model Based Integration of ODEs, SIAM JNA 45, 236-262

literature.claim: Validated Taylor arithmetic must enclose coefficient rounding and remainder.
literature.reference: Revol, Berz & Makino (2005), Reliable Implementation of Taylor Models in COSY

literature.claim: Explicit/implicit RK can be adapted to validated integration with separate enclosure machinery.
literature.reference: Chapoutot et al. (2015), Validated Explicit and Implicit Runge-Kutta Methods

literature.claim: Stiffness indicators can guide switching but are not validated stability proofs.
